title: FSSAI Packaging and Labelling Regulatory Standards for Milk Pouches
authority: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI)
applicable_regulations: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020

mandatory_declarations_on_milk_pouches.product_name: Clear declaration of product name and classification (e.g. Full Cream Milk, Toned Milk, Standardised Milk)
mandatory_declarations_on_milk_pouches.net_quantity: Net quantity in standard SI units (mL or L) with minimum numeral height as per pack volume
mandatory_declarations_on_milk_pouches.fssai_logo_and_license: FSSAI logo with 14-digit central/state license number displayed prominently
mandatory_declarations_on_milk_pouches.date_marking: Date of packaging and 'Use by' / 'Best before' date with explicit temperature storage guidance
mandatory_declarations_on_milk_pouches.vegetarian_logo: Green filled circle inside green square border signifying 100% vegetarian product
mandatory_declarations_on_milk_pouches.consumer_care: Name, address, email, and telephone number of the manufacturer / consumer care cell
mandatory_declarations_on_milk_pouches.recyclability_marking: Plastic waste management thickness declaration and recycling triangle symbol (LDPE 4)
